summary: Delegate service-account handback + schedule cross-team hardware swap for lateral hire
description:
Issue summary: New lateral hire transferring from ML Platform to Serving Runtime requires coordinated handback of delegated service accounts, scheduled swap of assigned GPU workstation, and temporary overlap of access.

Impact: Without coordinated handback and a tested swap window, there is risk of both teams losing access to critical service accounts or having duplicated KMS workflows. This could interrupt model rollouts and slow on-call coverage.

Background: Employee (internal transfer) will move teams on 2026-03-18. Current assets: Dell XPS 15 (work laptop), NVIDIA RTX A5000 bench GPU node (assigned via asset tag ASSET-1492), and delegated service-account sa-model-deploy-ops with limited KMS unwrap permissions. Destination team requires the bench GPU and original laptop; origin team requires a temporary service account with reduced privileges during a 72-hour overlap for runbook knowledge transfer.

Requested actions:
- Create a timeboxed service-account (sa-delegate-temp-INT-61122) with explicit TTL 72h and scoped permissions matching origin team's least privilege template.
- Schedule a hardware swap window with Facilities/Logistics and SRE to move bench GPU node on 2026-03-19 09:00-11:00 PST.
- Rotate KMS envelope keys used by sa-model-deploy-ops and update key rotation document; provide confirmation when KMS rewrap is complete.
- Update asset registry: transfer ASSET-1492 ownership to receiving team and ticket closure entry.
- Document the handback checklist in Confluence and attach runbook link to this ticket.

Risks/Constraints: Networking changes to access the bench node in us-west may require firewall exceptions; bench has a pinned allocation on dedicated cluster that could be affected by autoscaling. Requesting SRE on-call to approve the scheduled window.

Timeline: Need all tasks completed prior to 2026-03-20 to avoid blocking Monday deployments.
steps_to_execute:
1) Provision sa-delegate-temp-INT-61122 with TTL=72h using IAM automation playbook.
2) Add service-account to origin team's allowlist for 72h, remove high-priv roles, and log IAM audit.
3) Coordinate with Facilities to book courier + SRE to cordon bench node, perform asset swap, and validate GPU health (nvtop, dmesg).
4) Trigger KMS rewrap of envelope key for sa-model-deploy-ops; validate decryption on both sides.
5) Update asset registry and set new owner tags; close swap subtask.
investigation_notes: Confirmed asset tag ASSET-1492 assigned to user: previously used by eng:tayla. Last inventory ping 2026-03-08.
Checked IAM logs: sa-model-deploy-ops last used for deploy on 2026-03-07 22:14 UTC; no recent elevated-role grants. Recommend TTL flow to avoid permanent permission duplication.
SRE advised bench GPU is on dedicated-pool-3 with maintenance window Thursday mornings; suggested swap on 2026-03-19 to minimize disruption.
